title: Understanding the Prediction Vector
text: The prediction vector \( \hat{Y} \) is the result of multiplying the design matrix \( X \) by the parameter vector \( \hat{\theta} \). Think about the dimensions of \( X \) and \( \hat{\theta} \) to determine the shape of \( \hat{Y} \).

title: Dimensions of the Design Matrix
text: The design matrix \( X \) includes an intercept and has $$400$$ flight records. What does this tell you about the number of rows in \( X \)?

title: Dimensions of the Parameter Vector
text: The parameter vector \( \hat{\theta} \) corresponds to the number of columns in \( X \), which includes the intercept. How many parameters are there in total?

title: Shape of the Design Matrix
text: What is the shape of the design matrix \( X \) if it includes an intercept and $$9$$ features?

title: Shape of the Parameter Vector
text: What is the shape of the parameter vector \( \hat{\theta} \) if it corresponds to the number of columns in \( X \)?

title: Calculating the Shape of \( \hat{Y} \)
text: Given the shapes of \( X \) and \( \hat{\theta} \), what is the resulting shape of \( \hat{Y} \) when you multiply them?
